title: teofurlan.com: home page directions
brief: Personal portfolio home for Teo Furlan: two legs (software with AI agents, hardware), personal-story thread from a kid at a computer to agents and robot arms; recruiter 10-second test.

artboards.title: Cover and sheets (04 + 05)
artboards.tradeoff: Round 3. The exploded view is the cover; the body is the numbered sheet set with schematics and a title block. Dark blueprint and light paper themes with a toggle. Clear and complete; the cover effect only plays once, at the top

artboards.title: Exploded index (04 + 05)
artboards.tradeoff: Round 3. The exploded stack is a sticky side map; the plate for the current section lifts out as you read. Dark blueprint and light paper themes with a toggle. The scroll interaction explains the page all the way down; costs 280 px of width on desktop and a strip on phones
